shared_elements: low-relief figural carving on a flat stone surface
profile view of a living creature
justification:
Both surfaces carry figures carved in shallow relief seen in profile, and in each a hand/forearm is a distinct rendered element, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows two densely detailed bearded human figures with patterned hair, beards and garments facing one another, while B shows schematic, outline-only quadrupeds/reptilian creatures crawling across a plain pillar with no human figures or ornament 
involved.
